attempts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: brand-new square 1:1 cover painting for the children's science storybook “Rivers, Reservoirs & the Sea”. This is a completely new composition, not an edit and not a repair.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact recurring cast and outfit identity reference; Image 2 is the approved Book 1 cover style reference; Image 3 is this book's interior style and connected river-system reference.
Scene/backdrop: a high valley panorama seen from an OPEN grassy low hilltop viewpoint. One continuous blue river begins at a clearly visible reservoir held behind a small dam in misty green hills, runs downhill past patchwork fields and through a friendly town, then widens into one unmistakable mouth at a broad calm sea. The full reservoir/dam → river → fields → town → sea route must read instantly, including at 280 px.
Subjects: foreground, full-body and unobstructed, the exact recurring older girl and younger boy from Image 1. The girl has a brown chin-length bob, cream cardigan, pink tiny-floral dress, cream socks, dusty-pink shoes. She points along the river toward the sea with one arm; her other arm and hand hang naturally and visibly. The boy has curly light-brown hair, blue-and-white striped T-shirt, blue shorts, socks and neutral shoes; he turns his head and gaze where she points. Beside the boy's feet sits Vanilla, the exact small white-dominant chestnut-patched papillon from Image 1, about 4 kg and only one-quarter to one-third of the children's height, seated naturally with all four paws on the ground and all four legs readable.
Style/medium: exactly the calm luminous paper-cut watercolour and gouache on subtly textured cream paper of Images 2 and 3; clean rounded shapes, fine coloured-pencil edges, rain-blue, leaf-green and sunny-yellow palette, gentle daylight, quiet wonder.
Composition/framing: square. Children occupy the lower-left foreground on short mown grass with clear space around their silhouettes. Show both children head-to-toe. Leave some quiet pale sky in the upper centre. The river journey sweeps diagonally through the open valley behind them to the sea.
Anatomy acceptance: girl exactly 2 arms, 2 distinct hands, 2 separate legs and 2 visible feet; boy exactly 2 arms, 2 distinct hands, 2 separate legs and 2 visible feet; no crossed or merged limbs. Vanilla exactly 4 legs and 4 paws, all on the ground and visually distinct. Nothing overlaps or hides any body, arm, hand, leg, foot, paw, shoe or sock.
Hard constraints: absolutely NO bridge, railing, fence, wall, post, balustrade, bench, sign, foreground rock, bush, flowers, or tall grass in front of or between the figures. Only low short grass underfoot. No object may cross any body silhouette. One child only of each identity; one dog only. No text, letters, words, numbers, labels, logo, signature, border or watermark. Safe calm shallow-looking water; no danger or storm.
Avoid: bridge composition, viewing platform, extra limbs, missing limbs, hidden feet, merged hands, dog standing upright, dog larger than one-third child height, ambiguous river branches, multiple sea mouths, photorealism, 3D rendering.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: final square children's storybook cover.
Input images: Image 1 is the new cover composition and edit target. Image 2 is the exact Vanilla identity/marking/scale reference.
Primary request: Change ONLY Vanilla's pose so all four of her legs and all four paws are unmistakably visible and separately countable at full size and at a 280 px thumbnail. Keep her beside the boy's feet, small at one-quarter to one-third of the children's height, white-dominant with chestnut patches, large fringed papillon ears and plumed tail. Use a natural seated three-quarter pose with both straight front legs and paws clearly separated in front, plus both bent hind legs and both hind paws clearly visible on the grass to the left and right of her body; trim/arrange the long fur so it does not conceal, merge or imitate any leg or paw.
Preserve exactly: the entirely new open grassy viewpoint composition; the girl and boy identities, expressions, outfits, poses, anatomy and every visible limb; the girl's pointing gesture; the complete reservoir/dam → river → fields → town → single sea-mouth route; landscape, sky, palette, lighting, crop, dimensions and watercolour/gouache texture.
Hard constraints: exactly one dog; exactly four dog legs and four grounded paws, all visible and distinct; dog not upright and not larger than one-third child height. No bridge, railing, fence, wall, post, bench, sign, tall grass, bush, flower or foreground object crossing any human or dog limb. No text, letters, words, numbers, label, logo, signature or watermark. Do not alter anything except the dog's pose.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: final square children's storybook cover.
Input images: Image 1 is the new cover composition and edit target. Image 2 is the exact Vanilla identity/marking/scale reference.
Primary request: Change ONLY Vanilla into a small FRONT-FACING NATURAL SEATED POSE that makes all four legs and all four paws independently visible and countable. Place her beside the boy's feet. Her two slim straight front legs must be separated by a clear strip of grass, ending in two separate front paws. Her two bent hind thighs must visibly project to the left and right of her body, each ending in its own separate hind paw on the grass, like a small dog sitting squarely toward the viewer. Her body fur must stop above the paws and must not conceal any leg. Her plumed tail curls to one side without overlapping any leg. Preserve exactly: the new open grassy viewpoint; the girl and boy identities, expressions, outfits, poses, anatomy and every visible human limb; the girl's pointing gesture; the complete reservoir/dam → river → fields → town → single sea-mouth route; all landscape, sky, palette, lighting, crop and watercolour/gouache texture.
Binary anatomy requirement: exactly 4 dog legs must be visibly attached to the dog—left front, right front, left hind, right hind—and exactly 4 separate paws must touch the grass. No leg or paw may be hidden behind fur, body, tail, grass, another leg, or the boy. The four paws must remain distinguishable at 280 px.
Hard constraints: exactly one dog; dog seated, never upright on hind legs, never larger than one-third child height. No bridge, railing, fence, wall, post, bench, sign, tall grass, bush, flower or foreground object crossing any human or dog limb. No text, letters, words, numbers, label, logo, signature or watermark. Do not alter anything except Vanilla's pose.

Scale her entire seated figure down uniformly in place so her vertical height from the lowest grounded paw to the highest ear tip is about ONE QUARTER (25%) of the older girl's full standing height from shoe sole to top of hair, and no more than ONE THIRD (33%) of the boy's full standing height from shoe sole to top of hair. images.name: basin
images.prompt: High oblique complete river basin: dashed ridge boundary, rain-fed tributaries joining downhill into a widening main river and delta; all arrows downstream; no labels.

images.name: upstream-travels
images.prompt: Three sequential moments along the same river: one blue parcel advances downstream, clock hands differ, and the town gauge rises only in the final panel; no text.

images.name: level-rises
images.prompt: One fixed staff gauge and bank with low, highest after-rain and middle receding levels, weather icons and a friendly officer on dry ground; no text.

images.name: reservoir
images.prompt: Valley cross-section with reservoir only upstream of a strong dam, two safe stored levels below crest and one designed low outlet feeding the downstream river; no leak or overtopping.

images.name: in-and-out
images.prompt: Equal rainy/dry reservoir cross-sections: broad-in/narrow-out with higher storage, then narrow-in/broad-out with lower storage; designed outlet, house and rice field downstream.

images.name: bottleneck
images.prompt: Plan view: exactly two tributaries join above one narrow reach; downstream arrows compress and water backs up only upstream, then returns to normal flow below; calm towns.

images.name: tide-gate
images.prompt: Preserve the two stacked tide comparison, outward arrows, moon/clock icons, city thought bubbles and relative sea levels; remove every gate, barrier, control structure and embankment across the channel so the river mouth openly meets the sea; no reverse flow or text.

images.name: one-system
images.prompt: One connected rainy-hills to streams to reservoir to dam outlet to river/town to exactly one broad river mouth and calm sea; all arrows downstream; sun-to-moon arc and low/high-tide icon inset; no text.

images.name: closing
images.prompt: Exact cover cast on a broad dry river-mouth promenade at dusk, safely behind a railing, waving to one distant calm fisherman while Vanilla watches; river journey visibly ends at sea.
